summary: Partial submission: 11 outward prerequisite links (8 explicit, 3 inferred) to AlgebraicTopology, BelyiMaps and LieGroups; no inward links established. Three concrete scope splits concern generic associated covers, covering Lie groups and absolute versus relative homotopy. The handoff records the misplaced van Kampen prerequisite, opposite-action convention and punctured-disc classification gap. Catalogue-wide screening remains incomplete; this is not an exhaustive link inventory or an integration-ready completion.

overlaps.detail: UniversalCovers Stage 2 lists pi_1-set classification as an alternative route; Belyi 6.2 specifies its generic inverse-monodromy associated-cover construction and already labels it an unresolved UniversalCovers supplier contract. Both texts therefore touch the same generic mathematics, but its exact owning stage and API still need reconciliation.
overlaps.proposal: Make the supplier split already intended by Belyi explicit: UniversalCovers owns the generic associated-cover functor with its topology, projection-covering theorem, fibre equivalence, monodromy calculation, equivariant functoriality and orbit/component comparison. Keep finite numbered/pointed/unnumbered triple classifications and branch-point actions in Belyi or its declared successor. Preserve the distinction between product-to-quotient and associated-cover-to-base covering maps; the former does not prove the latter.

overlaps.detail: LieGroups Layer 5 lists construction of the underlying universal covering space alongside its new group law and smooth structure; the generic topological construction is already the scope of UniversalCovers Stage 0.
overlaps.proposal: Import the UniversalCovers carrier and lifting property rather than build a second path quotient. Keep the lifted group operations, smooth covering homomorphism, Lie-algebra comparison and central-kernel calculation in LieGroups. Separate the early cover construction, needed by Layer 4's Lie III proof, from the later descent refinement that uses Layer 4; the current whole-layer dependency would otherwise conceal a cycle.

overlaps.detail: Both texts list pointed maps, functoriality and basepoint change for cubical homotopy groups. AlgebraicTopology expressly consumes that absolute API but also repeats it in Stage 8.1 while extending to pairs.
overlaps.proposal: Keep the absolute cubical induced-map, basepoint-change and boundary-relative representative API in UniversalCovers Stage 3. AlgebraicTopology Stage 8 imports it and owns relative homotopy groups of based pairs, connecting maps, Kan comparison and Hurewicz--Whitehead. Record this split in declaration-level dependencies rather than making the entire roadmaps depend on one another.
